channel.title: The Oslo Brief
channel.description: A short audio briefing on markets, Norway and the world, published every morning and evening. Rates, earnings, Nordic property, energy and the news that moves them.

item.title: Friday 27 November, evening
item.description: Wall Street caps a strong week with a half-day rally, oil gives back its gains, Altria weighs a bid for Imperial Brands, FrP presents its budget, and Nordic property rises for a fourth day.
item.itunes:summary: Wall Street caps a strong week with a half-day rally, oil gives back its gains, Altria weighs a bid for Imperial Brands, FrP presents its budget, and Nordic property rises for a fourth day.

item.title: Friday 27 November, morning
item.description: Asia rallies and US futures rise ahead of Wall Street's half day, oil climbs as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia widen, gold jumps, and Norway's budget heads for Monday's deadline.
item.itunes:summary: Asia rallies and US futures rise ahead of Wall Street's half day, oil climbs as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia widen, gold jumps, and Norway's budget heads for Monday's deadline.

item.title: Thursday 26 November, evening
item.description: Europe rallies as US caps tariffs at deal rates, oil climbs ahead of OPEC+, Norway's mainland economy nearly stalls, and Nordic property extends its rally.
item.itunes:summary: Europe rallies as US caps tariffs at deal rates, oil climbs ahead of OPEC+, Norway's mainland economy nearly stalls, and Nordic property extends its rally.

item.title: Thursday 26 November, morning
item.description: Wall Street's 4.6% intraday plunge and recovery, credit warnings on Oracle and Nvidia, a Houthi attack claim on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery, and Norway's budget standoff.

item.title: Wednesday 25 November, evening
item.description: US proposes tariffs on 14 economies as sticky inflation locks in a December Fed hike; Norway's budget deal lacks a majority; Nordic property rallies; Deere.
